query:
INSERT INTO members_workplaces
    ( workplace_id
    , member_id
    , became_representative_at
    )
VALUES
    ( $1, $2, CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN now() ELSE NULL END )
ON CONFLICT
    ( workplace_id
    , member_id
    )
DO UPDATE
SET became_representative_at =
    CASE WHEN $3::boolean
         THEN COALESCE(members_workplaces.became_representative_at, now())
         ELSE NULL END
